lesson.menu_desc: The first minute of a support call: your name, your job, your company and the problem -- verb to be
lesson.subtitle: Lesson 1 -- Hello, IT Support
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Diogo Campos Silva | Lesson 1 -- Hello, IT Support
lesson.grammar_point: verb to be (I am, you are, it is: affirmative, negative and questions)

listenings.text: Thank you for calling Microsoft Support. Your call is important to us. The wait time is five minutes. Please have your ticket number ready. If it is urgent, please stay on the line. An analyst is ready to help you soon.

Hello, my name is Ravi. I am a support engineer at a security company. I am in Bangalore, in India. It is six thirty in the evening here. My team is small. We are five engineers, and we are online all night. Your ticket is open, and I am here to help.

extra_audio.text: Diogo is an IT analyst in Brazil. An email account is not working. He calls Microsoft Support. Karen says: Hello, I am Karen. How can I help you? Diogo says: Hi, I am Diogo. I have a problem.
